title: The perception-production link in L2 vowel imitation by Mandarin learners of English
why_promising: Primary L2 English imitation productions; all recorded imitations were manually vowel-boundary annotated in Praat by three phonetically trained RAs; a common 12% subset was independently annotated by all three for Krippendorff-alpha reliability; vowel duration and midpoint F1/F2 were derived from the manual intervals.
open_question: Locate/enumerate the public data deposit or supplement and verify whether token-level production measurements and/or manual interval files are publicly downloadable; isolate production from perception data.

title: Prosodic Cues for Broad, Narrow, and Corrective Focus in Persian
why_promising: Primary Persian production with synchronized 3D EMA and acoustic recordings; four acoustic time intervals were manually annotated in Praat by a native Persian speaker; study analyzes duration, F0, and intensity and the collection potentially contains articulatory trajectories beyond the published acoustic analysis.
open_question: Locate the authoritative public repository/supplement, enumerate acoustic and EMA files, verify public access/license, and determine whether synchronized EMA trajectories and manual interval boundaries are deposited.
